candidate_model.selection_reason: Best single theory group in the frozen discovery sample; fixed before validation outcomes exist.

direction_check: The financial-integration coefficient must remain positive.
decision_rule: Temporal validation supports H8 only if financial integration has lower leave-one-asset-out RMSE than raw breadth and retains a positive coefficient in the fixed validation window.
guardrails: The validation window begins the day after the discovery window ends.
Do not move the dates, replace the candidate group, redefine any group, or change the loss metric after validation outcomes are available.
Use the same 23-asset classification universe; report missing outcome coverage rather than replacing assets.
Do not run the validation estimate before the window closes and the minimum coverage requirement can be evaluated.
Other groups and outcomes may be reported only as explicitly labelled exploratory diagnostics.
